title: Circle mark
summary: A hand-drawn ring closes around the number that matters on a screen; the rest dims, the marked card lifts and the camera leans in close.

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add circle-mark --name my-circle-mark
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-circle-mark/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-circle-mark/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.
when: point at one figure on a dashboard
the proof moment of a product demo
